preconditions.description: The number of vectors n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The number of dimensions m must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 2 for k in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(n)])
preconditions.description: Each vector must have either 1 or 2 coordinates equal to 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= m for x in [int(x) for x in input().split()[1:]] for _ in range(n))
preconditions.description: All coordinates of the vectors must be within the range from 1 to m.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the size of T modulo 10^9+7 and the size of S', followed by the indices of S' in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: len(S_prime) == min(len(subset) for subset in subsets if all(vector in T for vector in subset))
postconditions.description: The size of S' must be the minimum number of vectors needed to generate all vectors in T.

postconditions.expression: all(vector in T for vector in T)
postconditions.description: All vectors in T must be representable as sums of vectors from S'.
